**Status:** extracted structure. Membership is the declared grouping in `ArchitectureComponents`; each dependency below is a direct bytecode reference found by ArchUnit 1.5.0 in the production classes of `journal-ocsf-writer` and `journal-capture-tck` (172 top-level classes, test classes excluded). ## Components

| Component | Module | Responsibility | Classes | Libraries used |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Capture and replay entry points | `journal-ocsf-writer` | Acquires a CLI's native output (launching the CLI, reading standard input, or replaying a recording) and feeds it, with arrival times, to the run writer; carries the process outcome and archives the native session file unchanged. | `CliCapture`, `LiveCapture`, `OcsfWriterTool`, `Replay` |  |
| Run writer | `journal-ocsf-writer` | Records one run: accepts each declared source, frames it, selects its compatibility entry, hands each record to the source's mapper and routes the resulting events to the root core or a child core; owns flush, complete, interrupt and failure. | `OcsfRunWriter` |  |
| Source input and run facts | `journal-ocsf-writer` | The capture-facing input interface (byte chunks or whole records, each with the arrival time the caller observed) and the facts declared before input: the run, each source's identity and route, and writer settings. | `RunDescriptor`, `SourceDescriptor`, `SourceInput`, `WriterOptions` |  |
| Framing and native records | `journal-ocsf-writer` | Splits arbitrary byte chunks into lines and classifies each line before interpretation (parsed, malformed, undecodable, blank, incomplete); nothing is dropped. | `LineFramer`, `NativeRecord` |  |
| Compatibility selection | `journal-ocsf-writer` | Chooses at most one registry entry (source description, mapping contract, Java mapper) per source from the CLI, profile, route and version, reading only the version-bearing record before selection; no match means the input is retained, not interpreted. | `Compatibility`, `VersionBootstrap` |  |
| Source mappers | `journal-ocsf-writer` | Interpret one native record at a time under the selected mapping contract into OCSF-extension events or whole-record retention, naming the contract rule each event executes. | `AntigravityMcp`, `AntigravityStreamMapper`, `ClaudeChildUsage`, `ClaudeDefinitions`, `ClaudeMcp`, `ClaudeStreamMapper`, `ClaudeTranscriptMapper`, `CodexItems`, `CodexRolloutMapper`, `CodexStreamMapper`, `CopilotAccounting`, `CopilotDefinitions`, `CopilotEventsMapper`, `CopilotOtelMapper`, `CopilotTools`, `CopilotUsageReportMapper`, `ExecutionMetrics`, `ExecutionState`, `JunieSessionMapper`, `JunieStdoutMapper`, `JunieSummaryMapper`, `JunieUsage`, `MapperSupport`, `MappingContracts`, `McpObservations`, `OpaqueTextMapper`, `ReportedQuantities`, `SourceContext`, `SourceMapper`, `SourceMappers`, `UsageTranches` |  |
| Final assembly | `journal-ocsf-writer` | Assembles the declared sources of one execution under a reviewed profile into one new events.jsonl: holds each mapper's observations, gates sources on the identities they report, groups observations by declared joins, consolidates each multi-source entity field by field with its evidence and conflicts, and declares the assembly. | `Assembler`, `AssemblyDeclaration`, `AssemblyGate`, `AssemblyGrouping`, `AssemblyPlan`, `AssemblyProfile`, `EventMerge`, `FinalAssembly` |  |
| MCP protocol binding | `journal-ocsf-writer` | Generates the typed mcp_* objects and the binding table from the pinned official MCP JSON Schemas, embeds a protocol object or a CLI's partial projection into them losslessly, and names the official definitions a file must declare to be read offline. | `McpAllOf`, `McpAlternatives`, `McpBinding`, `McpBindingGenerator`, `McpBindingNames`, `McpCoverage`, `McpEmbedder`, `McpGeneratedFiles`, `McpNode`, `McpSchemaModel`, `McpUnionMatch` |  |
| Core persistence | `journal-ocsf-writer` | Writes each core's self-describing events.jsonl (declarations before the events that need them, then events) and its ancillary run.json, keeping a readable prefix at every flush and hashing what is on disk at finalization. | `CoreWriter`, `Declarations`, `DefinitionClosure`, `ProtocolDeclarations` |  |
| Schema and toolchain pins | `journal-ocsf-writer` | The pinned compiled OCSF schema (class and category ids are read, never hand-written) and the checksummed toolchain every package names. | `Pins`, `SchemaExcerpt`, `SchemaPin` |  |
| Lexically exact JSON (writer) | `journal-ocsf-writer` | The writer's own JSON value: numbers keep their spelling, member order is kept, duplicates are rejected; Jackson's tokenizer does the lexing and nothing else of Jackson is used. | `Jv` | `com.fasterxml.jackson.core` |
| Package reader | `journal-capture-tck` | Opens a run package from events.jsonl alone (or its directory), verifies pins and hashes, and exposes declarations, events, children and explicit diagnostics; it never fetches a registry or loads production classes. | `ocsf.CompatibilityHistory`, `ocsf.DeclaredFile`, `ocsf.Diagnostic`, `ocsf.Event`, `ocsf.McpProtocol`, `ocsf.OcsfPackage`, `ocsf.PackageReader`, `ocsf.RunManifest`, `ocsf.SchemaCatalog`, `ocsf.SemanticContract`, `ocsf.SemanticOperation`, `schema.McpValidation` | `com.fasterxml.jackson.databind`, `com.networknt.schema` |
| Independent oracle | `journal-capture-tck` | Registers independent expected facts and extracts actual assertions; executes attributed value, identity, preservation, origin and final-selection comparisons, retaining missing, ambiguous and unsupported outcomes. | `ocsf.AssemblyEvidence`, `ocsf.AssertionAccounting`, `ocsf.AttributedFacts`, `ocsf.EventOrigin`, `ocsf.ExpectedSources`, `ocsf.FactComparison`, `ocsf.FinalComparisons`, `ocsf.FinalIdentity`, `ocsf.FinalRelation`, `ocsf.FinalSelection`, `ocsf.McpChecks`, `ocsf.OcsfOracle`, `ocsf.OracleReport`, `ocsf.OriginComparisons`, `ocsf.ProtocolComparisons`, `ocsf.Reconstruction`, `ocsf.SourceReferences`, `ocsf.UsageComparison`, `ocsf.UsageComparisons` |  |
| Source profiles | `journal-capture-tck` | State, from a native artifact's records alone and independently of the writer's mappers, which facts it reports: the expected population and exact values per fact family. | `ocsf.AntigravityNativeDetails`, `ocsf.AntigravityStreamProfile`, `ocsf.ClaudeChildUsageReading`, `ocsf.ClaudeNativeDetails`, `ocsf.ClaudeStreamProfile`, `ocsf.ClaudeTranscriptProfile`, `ocsf.CodexNativeDetails`, `ocsf.CodexRolloutProfile`, `ocsf.CodexStreamProfile`, `ocsf.CopilotProfile`, `ocsf.CopilotRedundancy`, `ocsf.CopilotTelemetryReading`, `ocsf.CopilotToolReading`, `ocsf.CopilotUsageReading`, `ocsf.ExecutionMetricReading`, `ocsf.ExecutionStateReading`, `ocsf.ExpectedFacts`, `ocsf.FamilyFacts`, `ocsf.JunieProfile`, `ocsf.McpReadings`, `ocsf.NativeContent`, `ocsf.NativeDetails`, `ocsf.NativeRedundancy`, `ocsf.NativeRule`, `ocsf.OpaqueTextProfile`, `ocsf.ReportedQuantityReading`, `ocsf.ResponseFacts`, `ocsf.SourceBindings`, `ocsf.SourceFacts`, `ocsf.SourceProfile`, `ocsf.SourceReaders`, `ocsf.SourceVariant`, `ocsf.TrancheReading` |  |
| Analysis views | `journal-capture-tck` | Compute the named deterministic operations a package's semantic contract declares from the saved core alone, and measure a core's bytes. | `ocsf.AnalysisViews`, `ocsf.PackageMeasure` |  |
| Reader command line | `journal-capture-tck` | The inspect, views, measure, reconstruct, self-contained and verify commands, with exit statuses that keep refusal, defects and incompleteness apart. | `ocsf.OcsfReaderTool` | `com.fasterxml.jackson.databind` |
| Neutral JSON, bytes and check ledger | `journal-capture-tck` | Vendor-neutral reading: JSON through Jackson's tokenizer only with exact numbers, native artifacts read as bytes first with every line kept, hashing, and the check outcomes and ledger every verifier reports with. | `ocsf.NativeArtifact`, `verify.Check`, `verify.CheckLedger`, `verify.CheckReport`, `verify.Difference`, `verify.Json`, `verify.NeutralJson` | `com.fasterxml.jackson.core` |

| Native inventory tools *(not drawn)* | `journal-capture-tck` | Empirical variant/path inventories of native artifacts and their comparison with the accepted source specifications (findings are proposals, never applied); source joins and the independent assembly oracle, which judges a finally assembled file from native identities alone. | `ocsf.inventory.AssemblyAccounting`, `ocsf.inventory.AssemblyConsolidation`, `ocsf.inventory.AssemblyMembership`, `ocsf.inventory.AssemblyOracle`, `ocsf.inventory.AssemblyPartition`, `ocsf.inventory.ExternalSchemaPaths`, `ocsf.inventory.InventoryComparison`, `ocsf.inventory.NativeInventoryTool`, `ocsf.inventory.RawInventory`, `ocsf.inventory.SourceAvailability`, `ocsf.inventory.SourceJoin`, `ocsf.inventory.SourceLocator`, `ocsf.inventory.SourceSpecification` | `com.fasterxml.jackson.databind` |
